tasks.title: Add proven YAML semantic merge and safe pending-send retry to repository-db
tasks.priority_reason: Deals publishing was blocked by a technically false conflict and normal concurrent editing was unusable.
tasks.summary: Implement deterministic structural merge, bounded audit metadata handling, precise conflict evidence and explicit retry for engine-recorded clean pending sends; cover safe and unsafe fixtures.
risk_notes: No broad last-write-wins behavior was introduced for business data.
acceptance_criteria: Safe field-level and id-keyed-array merges send successfully without an engine conflict marker.
Every ambiguous business merge stays blocked and reports exact unresolved paths.
Retry refuses any changed pending head, dirty tree or external Git conflict.
tasks.outcome: The engine now structurally merges only proven-disjoint canonical YAML changes in its temporary send lane, preserves hard conflicts for unsafe cases, and allows retry only for the engine-recorded clean pending-send lane. The reviewed implementation was rebase-merged to main in c284970dc592cfe41aedb9d524b11c2dfa7d84c5.

evidence.label: Exact-head validation
evidence.path: bun test: 176 pass, 0 fail; bunx tsc --noEmit: pass

tasks.title: Integrate repository-db semantic conflict handling in Deals v3 and recover the held publish
tasks.priority_reason: A library-only commit did not restore the hosted Deals operator flow until its pinned consumer and UI used the new contract.
tasks.summary: Pin Deals to the reviewed library commit, show true conflict versus waiting-record counts, verify a synthetic end-to-end retry and then recover the held production batch through the standard lifecycle.
risk_notes: Active Deals data stayed read-only until engine and consumer evidence was complete.
acceptance_criteria: Deals panel distinguishes actual conflict paths from all pending draft resources.
Workspace-shaped Deals gates and synthetic retry pass on the pinned engine commit.
Active batch recovery meets the full repository-db post-send parity and validation gate.
tasks.outcome: Deals root and app/v3 now pin the immutable retry-safe engine commit. The earlier held data publish was recovered through the supported lifecycle without rewriting remote business values; deals-data v3 remains clean at 5bed5fdfb3b410766765127525e287d2711e60db. The consumer was rebase-merged in d24f88bc7836c913fff97b9002b3420c9a852b13 and the managed Deals v3 runtime was restarted from current main after dependency byte-parity and a 400-test validation gate.
